# Amendments Checklist: Realistic Lighting, Shadows & Material Rendering

**Purpose**: Unit tests for the requirements quality of the 2026-10-20 spec-quality amendments (FR-012..FR-014, revised FR-002/004/007/008/010/011, revised SC-003/SC-004, new clarifications session, revised Edge Cases and Assumptions) — validating the written requirements, not the implementation
**Created**: 2026-10-20
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit.checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 - Are the initial states of ALL lighting controls at page load specified (ambient 50, "Shadows" ON, main light defaults), not just the ambient default? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK002 - Are empty-state requirements (no model loaded) defined for every lighting control, including the transition from disabled to operable on model load? [Completeness, Spec §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK003 - Are accessibility requirements for the new controls specified beyond English labeling (keyboard-only operation, programmatic state exposure)? [Coverage, Spec §FR-013]
- [ ] CHK004 - Are small-screen requirements for the new controls quantified (touch-target size, no horizontal panel scrolling, breakpoint value)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-014]
- [ ] CHK005 - Does the ambient scale definition cover the meaning of both endpoints AND intermediate values, not only the range 0-100? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK006 - Are requirements defined for what "operable" restores when a model loads — i.e., do persisted session settings apply to the first model after an empty state? [Gap, Spec §FR-012/§FR-004]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK007 - Is "immediately" in the shadow-switch requirement bounded by an observable reference (next rendered frame, no transition animation)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-011]
- [ ] CHK008 - Is the exact visible label of the shadow switch ("Shadows") stated in the spec itself rather than only in supporting docs? [Clarity, Spec §FR-011]
- [ ] CHK009 - Is "full practical ambient intensity" (value 100) defined in user-observable terms (uniformly and clearly lit without washing out)? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK010 - Is the start/stop reference for the 5-second load measurement explicit (from triggering load to model appearing on screen)? [Measurability, Spec §FR-010/§SC-004]
- [ ] CHK011 - Is "programmatically exposed so assistive technologies can announce it" concrete enough for a non-technical reviewer to verify, while staying free of implementation detail? [Clarity, Spec §FR-013]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK012 - Is the amended SC-003 (direct visual inspection, no Blender reference) consistent across ALL feature documents — or do quickstart.md V5, tasks.md T017, plan.md and contracts/ui-contract.md still state a Blender reference render as REQUIRED? [Conflict, Spec §SC-003 vs quickstart.md/tasks.md/plan.md]
- [ ] CHK013 - Are the reset semantics consistent between FR-004 (reset on page reload only), the Key Entities "Lighting Settings" entry, the Assumptions, and the new clarification? [Consistency, Spec §FR-004/§Key Entities/§Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK014 - Is the distinction between the main-light switch and the "Shadows" switch (both remove shadows, for different reasons) documented consistently across FR-006, FR-011, Edge Cases and US2 acceptance scenarios? [Consistency, Spec §FR-006/§FR-011/§Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK015 - Is the emissive × shadows behavior (shadows not visible in emissive mode = expected) stated consistently in FR-008, Edge Cases and the display-mode compatibility requirement? [Consistency, Spec §FR-008/§Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK016 - Are the newly added FRs (FR-012, FR-013, FR-014) each covered by at least one acceptance scenario, edge case or quickstart scenario, as required for FR-001..FR-011? [Traceability, Spec §FR-012..014]
- [ ] CHK017 - Do any remaining spec sections still carry the superseded wording ("assumed: 50", "matching a Blender reference", unquantified "immediately", "noticeably sluggish") after the amendments? [Conflict, Spec §FR-004/§FR-007/§Edge Cases]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK018 - Can SC-003 be judged objectively by 3 non-technical testers (rough = no sharp mirror-like reflections; polished = highlights move with rotation) without any external artifact? [Measurability, Spec §SC-003]
- [ ] CHK019 - Can the SC-004 FPS targets (≥60 desktop, ≥30 mobile) be measured by a non-technical person — and do they respect the constitution's prohibition on criteria requiring dev tools? [Measurability, Spec §SC-004 vs Constitution III]
- [ ] CHK020 - Is the shadow-artifact quality threshold on thin/overlapping geometry expressed as observable pass/fail conditions (no acne stripes, tolerance for shadow loss, no flicker)? [Measurability, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK021 - Are the new success criteria (revised SC-003/SC-004) technology-agnostic, referencing tools (stopwatch, FPS meter) rather than implementation technologies? [Measurability, Spec §SC-003/§SC-004]

## Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK022 - Are alternate-flow requirements covered for users who keep all defaults and never touch the new controls (out-of-the-box default scene must be sensible)? [Coverage, Spec §US1 Acceptance 6]
- [ ] CHK023 - Are recovery requirements for ambient 0 + main light off written as expected behavior with an explicit "no automatic mechanism required" statement? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK024 - Are exception requirements retained for models lacking shadow-casting geometry or surface-finish data after the FR-007 amendment? [Coverage, Spec §FR-007/§Edge Cases/§US3 Acceptance 3]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK025 - Are both ambient boundary values (exactly 0, exactly 100) behaviorally specified after the scale amendment? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-002/§US1 Acceptance 2-3]
- [ ] CHK026 - Is the low-power mobile degradation threshold quantified (30 FPS floor, no freezing) rather than left as an adjective? [Clarity, Spec §Edge Cases/§SC-004]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [ ] CHK027 - Are performance budgets for the added rendering work (shadows + environment lighting) stated as explicit NFRs with numbers, not only inside SC-004? [NFR, Spec §FR-010/§SC-004]
- [ ] CHK028 - Are keyboard and assistive-technology requirements written so they can be checked without reading code (constitution Principle III)? [Measurability, Spec §FR-013 vs Constitution III]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK029 - Is the removal of the Blender-reference dependency reflected consistently in Assumptions AND in every document that previously treated it as a validation prerequisite? [Dependency, Spec §Assumptions vs quickstart.md §Prerequisites]
- [ ] CHK030 - Is the default ambient value 50 documented as a confirmed requirement everywhere (no leftover provisional/assumed markers in spec, plan or tasks)? [Assumption, Spec §FR-004/§Assumptions]

## Ambiguities & Conflicts

- [ ] CHK031 - Are the terms introduced by the amendments ("next rendered frame", "practical ambient intensity", "programmatically exposed", "touch targets") unambiguous for their intended (non-technical) audience? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-002/§FR-011/§FR-013/§FR-014]
- [ ] CHK032 - Do the amendments conflict with any constitution constraint (English-only, no build/Node, 5-second budget, no uploads, spec-defined scope)? [Conflict, Constitution v1.1.0]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit.implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit.specify` and `/speckit.clarify`; `checklists/quality.md` is a separate reviewer-owned review of the original spec
- Highest-risk items by impact: CHK012 (Blender dependency inconsistency across documents), CHK016 (new FRs without scenarios), CHK019 (FPS criterion vs constitution dev-tools ban), CHK030 (leftover provisional markers)
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference within this file
